description: Night vs day standardised risk ratio among crashes in darkness only
population: CRSS police-reported crashes 2016-2024 with known maximum severity (MAX_SEV 0-4)
method: Survey-weighted logistic models (exposure + every subset of covariate blocks; ridge 0.01 on mean-1 weights; exact cell compression); standardised predictive margins over all crashes; risk ratio = margin(all exposed) / margin(all reference); Taylor-linearised influence summed within 67 PSUs / 25 strata, t with 42 df; shares and Shapley values by the delta method across models
